# Architecture Decision Records Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System: URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Validate that material decisions are recorded completely, consistently and with human acceptance.
**Created**: 2026-10-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [ADRs](../../../docs/adr/README.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Item tags**: `[Mandatory]` means the criterion derives from the constitution, an approved requirement, or an accepted ADR or ruling. `[Optional]` means it concerns an enhancement. `[Dnn]` refers to a detection from the checklist brief; the detection map is in [../gates/release-evidence-gates.md](../gates/release-evidence-gates.md). Post-implementation evidence checks are in that gates file, not here. Every item is unchecked, including `[Optional]` items, so `/speckit-implement` reports this file as incomplete until a reviewer marks it.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Does every material decision in plan §12 map to exactly one ADR, with no material decision left without one? [Completeness, Plan §12; docs/adr/README.md] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK002 Does every ADR record at least two options, each with approach, advantages, disadvantages, risks, implementation impact and assessment implications? [Completeness, CON VII] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK003 Does every ADR's Traceability section cite requirement IDs, plan sections and PD or HD IDs? [Traceability, CON X] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK004 Does every ADR name a validation method tied to a specific test suite or artifact? [Measurability, CON XI] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK005 Does every ADR risk table give a mitigation for each listed risk, with no placeholder entries? [Completeness, CON VII] [Mandatory]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is each ADR's status recorded with approver and date, with no ADR shown Accepted without a recorded human approval? [Completeness, CON III; Human Gate 4] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK007 Is a supersession procedure defined, stating how an ADR is superseded and which plan, contract and test updates it triggers? [Gap, CON I; Governance §4] [D25] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK008 Is each ADR's reversibility stated together with what would have to change to reverse it? [Clarity] [Optional]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Are the ADR-006 (no dependency changes in change sets), ADR-014 (aliases 4–10 characters) and ADR-019 (analytics loss semantics) rulings reflected in, or traceable from, the requirements they constrain (FR-SHR-021, A-013)? [Consistency, Human Gate 4 rulings 1–3] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK010 Do the ADR index and the plan agree on numbering and scope (scheduler = ADR-003, graph representation = ADR-005, 19 ADRs)? [Consistency, CR-002] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK011 Are deferred decisions (BL-01 to BL-12) explicitly marked as not needing an ADR before implementation, with each disclosed as a limitation? [Clarity, docs/adr/README.md; Plan §14.1] [Optional]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- `[Gap]` = the requirement is missing; `[Ambiguity]` = the term or rule needs a definition; `[Conflict]` = two sources disagree; `[Assumption]` = relies on an unvalidated assumption
